t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ego ninh nit'odeetaaghatħ'aa' ts'a nits'a hadeenaaghasdaak ts'a haghanee go ninh kkokk'a neeseeneenłtaanh ts'a isee huyił asiniyh. Sinh nitħ'il eent'aanh dahoon see haħ eelst'ilaa. Doyonh eenlaanhh dahoon saahaa k'its'ohudeelt'aa (years) ełts'a kkutnit'ee ninh yaan' adit'odeeniłt'in. Ninh ya'at'odeeniłt'in.
